nix.et: A widespread form in dialects all over the German language area, probably the same as standard nichts, that is, a contraction of it.

s: nix (water demon in human form that lures people into the water and drowns them)
Nix.et: From Middle High German niches, nickes, from Old High German nihhus, nichus, from Proto-Germanic *nikwus, *nikwis, from Proto-Indo-European *nigʷ-ō-s, from Proto-Indo-European *neygʷ- (“wash”). Cognate with Old English nicor.

s: no!, no way!, no chance!; that's out of the question!

Nixe.et: From Middle High German nixe, from Old High German nicchessa, feminine form of nichus, nihhus (“water-spirit”), from Proto-Germanic *nikwus, *nikwis, perhaps from Proto-Indo-European *neygʷ- (“to wash”). More at nix, nicker.

t: Wir sind in Null Komma nix da.
We'll be there in no time.
Diese Mayonnaise ist nix als Chemie.
That mayo is nothing but chemicals!
Tom hat so gut wie nix in seiner Brieftasche.
Tom has next to nothing in his wallet.
Mir ging in Null Komma nix das Geld aus.
I quickly ran out of money.
l: Da wird ihn nix glücklich machen, was ich ihm zu sagen habe.
Also, sie ‚scheißt sich nix‘, wenn man das so sagen darf.
Mit Schlaf war da nix, aber sonst waren es tolle Erlebnisse.
